thread:
anya: Heads-up: CI started spitting out a ton of SAST/DAST failures this morning after an RBAC cleanup touching the build-keystore SA. errors look like KMS decrypt permission denials and then downstream scanners treat missing fixtures as code issues.

devon: I rolled the RBAC change in PR#5122 to remove broad decrypt rights from serviceAccount:build-keystore@redwood-prod. intent was least-priv, but didn't fully map which pipeline jobs impersonate it. If reverting is fastest, I can do that.

ravi: sample error from DAST harness: 
```
2026-04-02T03:10:22Z ERROR: failed to fetch test-catalog.json: KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied
Caused by: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied for serviceAccount:build-keystore@redwood-prod
```

anya: can someone check audit logs to confirm whether decrypt requests reached KMS and were DENIED vs not logged at all? use: ```gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"serviceAccount:build-keystore@redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.cryptoKeyVersions.*Decrypt\" --limit=20 --format=json\"```

ci-bot: Auto-detected incident: SEC-2026-APR02. Owner: devon. Evidence retention=14d.

devon: reverting now. Quick revert via terraform to reattach roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for the SA, then follow-up with a scoped grant plan. DRAFT PR 5130.

oncall-sre: applying revert in infra-prod. ETA ~2m.

oncall-sre: revert applied. audit log query shows DENIED entries at 03:10 and SUCCESS at 03:13 after revert.

ravi: kicked a new DAST run, fetch succeeded, noise gone. marking incident mitigated until we land the policy updates.

anya: follow-ups we agreed on in meeting: 1) add pre-merge checklist item when altering KMS/RBAC: run infra-smoke/kms-decrypt and confirm logs; 2) require PRs that touch KMS bindings to include a short Impact Statement + recommended TTL; 3) create an alert that pages infra on >3 PERMISSION_DENIED KMS decrypts for build-keystore SA in 5m. I'll draft RFC and SDLC checklist PR.

devon: I'll update PR 5130 to reapply with a 1h TTL and a justification block. will include example terraform snippet for a minimal key-specific binding and a link to the RFC when ready.

anya: Also propose we add a small change to SAST/DAST triage: a label "infra:blocker:<incident-id>" that triage can filter by so that automated findings from infra outages aren't triaged as real code issues. SecOps: can you add that label and retention flag?

sec-bot: Label infra:blocker:SEC-2026-APR02 applied to runs affected. Evidence retention set to 14d.

oncall-sre: recommend adding an automated CI preflight job under infra-smoke that runs when terraform diff touches any resource with "cloudkms" in name: it should attempt a single decrypt using the SA or impersonation flow described in the PR. I'll file infra ticket INFRA-198.

ravi: thanks. will re-scan the affected findings and mark as ignored under the infra:blocker label. leaving a note in issue tracker linking to the audit backfill.

anya: assigned tasks: devon (regrant with TTL + PR), anya (RFC + SDLC checklist PR), oncall-sre (infra-smoke job ticket + alert), sec-ops (label runs). closing the loop once PR + RFC merged. :thumbsup:
